title: SimulationCompleted
description: Terminal event. Run transitions to COMPLETED on emission. riskMetrics must equal the latest RiskMetricsCalculated payload (Defining 200-Q1.5 invariant).

durationMs.description: Total wall-clock duration from SimulationRequested to completion.

outputArtifacts.description: Files written under ./output/<runId>/. Always includes metrics.json and at least one PNG.
